description: Preview cart/order data without saving or sending. Returns explicit field-mapping suggestions, ambiguous numeric price candidates, visual preset settings, and previewItems for the selected scenario. Existing itemFields are preserved. Apply chosen suggestions/preset fields using update_sequence_node or template/campaign updates; render_email accepts the previewItems at your block source in variables. Scenario data is sample-only; use real to restore the supplied items. Price candidates have unknown units: confirm cents before mapping priceCents; set priceUnit to major for major-unit prices; omitted priceUnit preserves cents. No account data is read. Requires a valid API key; no additional scopes.
